definitions.explanation: An intensifier used to emphasize the truth or degree of something; often expresses genuine feeling or evaluation.

examples.japanese: {実|じつ}に⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{実|じつ}に⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧⟦な→な：noentry⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{実|じつ}に⟦{興味深|きょうみぶか}い→興味深い：20118_kyoumibukai⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{実|じつ}に is a formal adverb that intensifies what follows, conveying that the speaker genuinely feels or evaluates something to be true. It often carries a sense of impressed or heartfelt emphasis.

POSITION:
Placed directly before the adjective, adverb, or phrase it modifies: {実|じつ}に⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧ (truly wonderful), {実|じつ}に⟦{残念|ざんねん}→残念：01244_zannen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (truly regrettable).

REGISTER:
Formal and literary. Common in speeches, essays, and written prose. In casual conversation, ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧ or ⟦すごく→すごく：18751_sugoku⟧ are preferred.

CONTRAST:
- {実|じつ}に: indeed, truly (formal, emphatic)
- ⟦{本当|ほんとう}に→本当に：04714_hontouni⟧: really (general use, all registers)
- ⟦{誠|まこと}に→誠に：28350_makotoni⟧: truly (very formal, humble, used in business)
- ⟦すごく→すごく：18751_sugoku⟧: very (casual, colloquial)
